      Our Story About us

      AsureQuality provides the broadest range of food assurance services in NZ, with 150 years of experience working in our food and production sectors.
      Laboratory Testing Our Services

      AsureQuality’s accredited laboratories provide expert testing for food, dairy, horticulture, pharmaceutical, and environmental products. Ensure safety, quality, and compliance with the trusted leaders in testing.

      Training Academy

      AsureQuality Academy offers professional training solutions for food and primary industries, specialising in all aspects of food safety.

    Industries

    Dairy Manufacturing

    As experts in the dairy sector, AsureQuality offers specialised testing, auditing, and certification services to ensure product safety, quality, regulatory compliance, and global market access for dairy manufacturers.

    Learn more

    Food Manufacturing

    AsureQuality supports food manufacturers with testing, auditing, and certification services to ensure food safety, quality, compliance, and market access both locally and globally.

    Learn more

    Horticulture

    AsureQuality provides testing, auditing, and certification services to the horticulture sector, ensuring food safety, quality, and compliance with global standards, including residue testing, farm audits, and GlobalG.A.P. certification.

    Learn more

    Pharmaceutical

    We provide comprehensive GMP testing services to the pharmaceutical. nutraceutical and medicinal cannabis industries at our Medsafe Certified laboratories.

    Learn more

    Meat Processing

    Working alongside partners at Aotearoa's meat processing plants to enhance all aspects of the value chain to ensure animal products meet the highest global standards of quality.
